content.text:
The Chat agent now sends each incoming message to Llama 3.3 70B and sends the reply back. I haven't run or tested it.

**Changes:**
- **`src/index.js`**: `onMessage` creates the Workers AI provider from `this.env.AI`. It calls `generateText` with `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`, using the message as the prompt, and sends the generated text back on the same connection. If a message arrives as binary data, it is converted to text first. If the call fails, the error is logged and the client gets a short apology instead of an unhandled exception.
- **`wrangler.jsonc`**: added `"ai": { "binding": "AI" }`.
- **`package.json`**: added `"ai": "^7.0.0"` and `"workers-ai-provider": "latest"`.

**Check the versions:** I couldn't look up packages on npm here because those commands needed approval. I chose `ai` ^7 because `agents` 0.27.0 develops against that version and accepts ^6 or ^7. I set `workers-ai-provider` to `latest` because I couldn't confirm which version supports AI SDK v7. After `npm install`, change it to the installed version (e.g. `^x.y.z`). Also make sure npm doesn't warn about a mismatch between that package and `ai`.

**Running it:** each message is a standalone prompt, so the model doesn't see earlier messages. Workers AI calls go to Cloudflare and are billed to your account, including during `wrangler dev`.
